Cc: Billing <billing@greenleaf.health>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal billing split + VAT question

Hi Soojin,

We’re finalizing our procurement calendar for the Redwood renewal (DL-78921). Legal and Finance have asked whether Redwood can issue the renewal invoice in three staggered invoices (May / Aug / Nov) to align with our budget tranches. Also — we’re EU VAT-registered; can you confirm if Redwood can move the VAT allocation to the first invoice only, with the later two invoices net of VAT, assuming we provide our VAT ID?

If this is possible please also confirm the amount per invoice and any impact on the final true-up. We expect a small overage from Q1 usage that should net against the first stage.

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Hayes
Head of Procurement | Greenleaf Health
billing@greenleaf.health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@greenleaf.health>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-26T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal billing split + VAT question

Hi Oliver — thanks for the note and the heads-up on timing. Short answers up-front: yes, we can do a staggered invoice schedule; and yes, we can allocate the VAT to the first invoice provided Greenleaf supplies a valid EU VAT ID and VAT certificate. A few details and asks below so we can get our finance team to issue clean invoices this week.

1) Proposed schedule (to match your tranches):
   - Invoice 1 (Stage 1): issued 2027-05-03, 40% of ARR + VAT (if applicable)
   - Invoice 2 (Stage 2): issued 2027-08-01, 30% of ARR (net of VAT)
   - Invoice 3 (Stage 3): issued 2027-11-01, 30% of ARR (net of VAT)

2) True-up / overage handling: we will apply the Q1 usage credit against Invoice 1. If the true-up results in a debit, that will be reflected on Stage 1; any residual adjustments will be settled on Invoice 3. Please confirm the exact amount of the overage so we can reflect it.

3) Required docs: greenleaf VAT ID and VAT certificate (PDF) to support net-of-VAT treatment on later invoices. Also confirm the bill-to legal entity name and the invoicing address (for tax/legal).

4) Payment terms: our standard is 30 days from invoice date for SEPA/ACH. If Greenleaf prefers a different term for internal reasons, say 45 days for Stage 2, flag it now so Finance can note it.

I’ve looped in Rachel (CS lead) to approve the rollout plan and Vivek (Finance) to prepare the staged invoices once we have the VAT docs.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
